offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based payroll, human capital management and workforce software to US employers, mainly mid-sized businesses. It delivers the software on a subscription basis and adds payroll processing and tax filing services.

primary_products.value: payroll software; HR and benefits software; talent management software; time and labor software

primary_services.value: payroll processing; tax filing; implementation services

customer_segment.value: B2B: US mid-sized employers across many industries

end_markets.value: professional services; manufacturing; healthcare; retail; hospitality

revenue_model.value: subscription: per-employee software subscriptions for payroll and HR; service fees: payroll processing, tax filing and implementation services; interest or premiums: interest earned on client funds held between payroll and tax payments
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: sells cloud HR and payroll platform to employers; service provider: runs payroll processing and tax filings for client employers; financial intermediary: holds and remits client payroll and tax funds
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US national: Employers across all 50 US states

specialization.value: related lines: payroll, HR, talent, time and benefits software sold to the same employers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales team selling to employers; partners / resellers: referral and channel partners such as accounting firms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing and employment, wage and data privacy rules
